translation.name: Dillꞌ wen dillꞌ   Kob C̱he   Jesucrístonaꞌ

book.name: Hebreos
book.title: Kart daa bseḻ' to beṉ' lao beṉ' hebreoka', beṉ'ka' nonḻilall' Jesucrístona'

content: Chioza' chbeje' yog' bx̱oz choo bx̱oz xenka' ladj beṉ' Israelka', na' chzoe'ne' kwenc̱he iṉabe' gaklene' beṉ' wlall c̱he'ka' na' lljwee lawe'na' yog' daa chzangakile', na' chite' bayix̱'ka' kwenc̱he chizi'xen Chioza' saaxya c̱he'ka'.
Na' beena' nak bx̱oz choo bx̱oz xen nape' yeḻ' chxenlall' c̱he beṉ'ka' chx̱iṉj chḻen daa bi ntegakile', ḻa' ḻekzka' zoe' dii nxoll wx̱iṉj wḻene' daa nake' beṉ' de beli chen.
Daan, chonan byen chite' bayix̱'ka' kwenc̱he yizi'xen Chioza' saaxya c̱he'na', na' ka'kz chone' c̱he beṉ' wlall c̱he'ka'.
Na' kono chzoa kwinin gake' bx̱oz choo bx̱oz xen tobia'loze', san Chiozan' chbeje' beena' gak bx̱oz choo bx̱oz xen c̱he', ka bene' c̱he dii Aarónna'.
Na' ḻekzka' Crístona', aga tobia'lozen' ben kwine' bx̱oz choo bx̱oz xen, san Chiozan' wlo'ene' balaaṉ daa bzoe'ne' nake' bx̱oz choo bx̱oz xen. Na' kwine' golle'ne':

content.text: na' ṉaa daa solo iṉabi'o iṉezi beṉ' nad' nak' X̱o'.

content: Na' ḻekzka' Cho'a Xtill' Chioza' nan:
Na' Crístona', shlak wbane' yell-lioni, wchelle' na' wṉie' zilljə, wṉabile' Chioza', beena' nap yeḻ' wak kwenc̱he yisle'ne' lao yeḻ' wita', na' daa goke' beṉ' wizoa dill', Chioza' bzenague' c̱he'.
Na' ḻa'kzi goke' Xiiṉ Chios, diika' bllagloe' benan ka wyajniile' daa nak yeḻ' wizoa dill'.
Na' ka', biyoll bido goke' ka chiyaḻ' gake' kwenc̱he wi'e yeḻ' mban daa bi te c̱heyin beṉ'ka' chzoa xtilleena'.
Na' Chioza' bzoe'ne' goke' bx̱oz choo bx̱oz xen ka gok Melquisedeca'.
Dii zanch de dii we'len' le' dill' c̱he diiki ba wnia', per chonan lallj wzajniida'n le' daa bi chonle ka dii le.

Ṉaa ba gok ssha nombia'le cho'a xtill' Chioza', len' ba chiyaḻ' wli' wsedilen beṉ' yoblə, sheḻ'ka'. Per le'lə ni chyalljzile no wzajni'chi le' diika' bi chontek lallj shajniile c̱he cho'a xtill' Chioza' daa ba bsedle. Ni chonzle ka bi'do' ni chall' na' biṉ' gak gaob' yeḻ' wao.
Na' nottezə beṉ' biṉ' shajniile' bi daa nak wen na' bi daa nak mal nake' ka bi'do' ni chall'.
San beṉ'ka' chzoac̱hec̱h chzenaggake' c̱he Chioza', chakbe'gakile' daa nak wen na' daa nak mal. Ḻegaken' nakgake' ka beṉ' ba cheej chao yeḻ' wao, aga ka bi'do'na' ni chall'.
